subject: expression: introduce new function for JSON array (#60728)
summary: Adds TiDB-specific SQL syntax `JSON_SUM_CRC32(expr AS <cast_type> ARRAY)`: parser token+AST (`JSONSumCrc32Expr`), planner expression rewrite to `expression.BuildJSONSumCrc32FunctionWithCheck`, and executor implementation (scalar+vectorized) that strictly casts JSON array elements to the declared array element type and returns a BIGINT sum of per-element `crc32( fmt("%v", casted_value) )`. Includes parser/expression/integration tests for success and expected error cases.
